# Purpose

This guide builds an 18-member, time-lagged MOGREPS-UK precipitation forecast at one point. Code is not evaluated during package builds because it accesses public network data.

# Workflow

```{r}
library(reach.meteo)

product <- mogreps_uk("precipitation_rate.nc")
dispatches <- available_dispatches(product, lookback_days = 2)
selected <- select_dispatches(dispatches, coverage = "latest_six")
request <- forecast_request(selected, "precipitation_rate.nc", maximum_lead_hours = 126)
remote <- catalogue(request)
local <- download_data(remote, "data/mogreps")
```

# Point extraction

```{r}
point_dt <- extract_ensemble_point(
  local,
  longitude = -0.2437,
  latitude = 52.5695,
  point_id = "Peterborough"
)
```

# Time-lagged composition

```{r}
lagged_dt <- compose_time_lagged_ensemble(
  point_dt,
  dispatches = 6,
  require_members = 18,
  incomplete = "drop"
)
```

# Rate conversion and accumulation

```{r}
rate_dt <- convert_precipitation_rate(lagged_dt)
accumulated_dt <- accumulate_ensemble(
  rate_dt,
  source = "rate",
  value_column = "rate_mm_per_hour"
)
```

# Plots

```{r}
plot_ensemble_series(rate_dt, "rate_mm_per_hour", "Precipitation rate (mm h-1)")
plot_ensemble_cumulative(accumulated_dt)
plot_cumulative_summary(accumulated_dt, require_members = 18)
plot_member_availability(lagged_dt, required_members = 18)
```
